prompt_en: Vertical intimate documentary photograph of one explicitly adult original character during a private late-night snack ritual at a small home kitchen window seat under one warm lamp. She has a severe straight bob, oval glasses, and a soft buttoned cardigan; her baseline is meticulous composure and a private rule of arranging exactly three fruit slices. Show her holding a precise three-piece fruit arrangement until one slice slips, catching it with two fingers, then failing to suppress one pleased mouth corner at the recovered pattern. The trigger is one fruit slice starting to slide from a chipped plate with three fruit slices and one crescent-shaped gap. The slipping fruit slice and the crescent-shaped gap it leaves stay visible. Her two catching fingers, tracking gaze, and escaped pleased mouth corner remain visible. She returns the slice to the exact three-piece pattern, leaving one tiny juice fingerprint on the plate rim. One tiny juice fingerprint on the plate rim reveals that the recovered pattern was not effortless. Her clearly adult face, straight bob, oval glasses, and cardigan remain consistent. Her face, catching fingers, slipping slice, and chipped plate share one tight focal plane. Warm lamp light and reflected color bind her face, fruit, and worn plate in the same light; 50mm medium close perspective, foreground table-edge blur, natural skin texture, one loose hair, a creased cardigan, contact shadow, and gentle focus falloff. The close distance feels observed rather than displayed, caught in the transition before her fingers settle. Nonsexual private humor, no posed glamour.
negative_en: awkward expression, over-processed retouching, fake-looking background, broken facial features, body distortion, distorted fingers, cartoon style, cropped-off head, illustration look, plastic-looking skin, duplicate faces, low resolution
